subject: [PATCH v5 14/19] selftests/mm: run every supported collapse order by default

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged selftest to run all supported collapse orders by default, rather than only running a single order when specified with the -c option. The test will now cover more scenarios and provide more comprehensive results. Additionally, the -c option is modified to pin one order instead of printing usage text, and range checking is added for source and collapse orders.
